record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only loss aggregation: compute the existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise loss mean over valid positions separately for each sequence, then average those sequence means. Current position averaging gives longer histories greater weight; equal sequence weighting may better match user-averaged validation HR@10. Preserve individual loss terms, sampling, optimizer, architecture, readout and all training settings; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Average the existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise loss within each sequence, then equally across nonempty sequences. This may better align training with user-averaged HR@10 by removing longer histories' greater aggregate weight. Apply the shared loss change to all four datasets while preserving architecture, inference, sampling and training settings.
